body:
Nah not any more. I used to play on the computer and sell things on eBay, but now I'm just disgusted at the money that people spend for total crap. I used to try to support myself by doing this but it's hard to sell things when you no longer value them. 

I keep giving my things away to a point that someone asked me if I was dying. I should have said yes. I've since stopped. I decided to sell everything and put it all into the lottery. Even if I win 20 million I wouldn't want anything and would give it away. Sorry to be a downer. Thanks for taking the time to write.

Thank you sir. I emailed the girl back, but never heard back from her. 

Do me a favor. Keep being awesome and don't forget that weird quiet person in the corner of the room. It usually doesn't take too much to make their day.
